title: Yellowed Crispy Italian Strawberry Fritters
description: A savory Italian dish from Puglia featuring strawberries and nuka-pickle, served in scallop shells, this recipe is gluten-free friendly. It brings back nostalgic memories of Italian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, eggs, parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced strawberries and chopped nuka-pickle to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the flour mixture.
Drizzle the olive oil over the strawberry mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Spoon the strawberry mixture into the scalloped shells, filling them about 3/4 of the way full.
Place the filled shells on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the fritters in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the fritters warm, garnished with additional grated parmesan cheese if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
